morphology.compounding_rule: Persian quality/relation + element via ezafe '-ahya' (Arta-xshaca truth-realm, Baga-data god-given) layered over clipped Woodland compounds (karhavana deep-forest, kanavitha clan-longhouse): the capital Wabanstan (dawn-land), Paridahenta-Riyata (the watered paradise-meadow), Karhavana-pura (the deep-forest city).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Persian court-and-feudal nobility carry a house (vith-X / ohvitha) and filiation 'X-ahya puthra' (son of X) or compact 'X-puthra'; the woodland substrate keeps the matrilineal clan-name (ohwachira, by animal-totem) held and bestowed by the clan-mother; the throne fuses both - a Xshayathiya who also belongs to a totem-clan-line through the clan-mothers.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen apadana-halls, dead fire-temples and abandoned palisade-castles: 'the dead Atashkanusa of [name]', 'the empty Kanata of [name]', 'the Ghost-Longhouse of [clan]'
patterns.military_units: the [number/power] Spada (host) and the longhouse war-bands: 'the Spada of Urlaspa', 'the Wolf-clan warriors', 'the Ten-Thousand (Anushiya)'
patterns.ships: forest river-and-lake craft and the few royal barges (a land-and-forest realm): 'Bearer of the Baji', 'the Swift Heron', 'Boat of Arzanta', 'the Dawn-Canoe'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Golden Farnah', 'The Cup of Truth (Arta-jam)', 'The Maple and Rose'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Persian-shifted reflexes PRIMARY (axsatran's Old-Persian-shifted set: Turvasa, Urlaspa, Naumana, Arzanta, Asturna), Woodland morphs SECONDARY (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.woodland: Tularonon, Oranhonon, Kayanonon, here softened toward the Persian register as Tularsa, Oransa, Kayansa), never real Iranian/Zoroastrian or Iroquois gods. Lawful henotheist but TOLERANT (the Persian lean): Asturna the Wise Lord most high upholds ARTA (Truth/Right-order) and the Lawful powers are His yazata-ministers; the Chaotic powers are the hosts of DRAUGA (the Lie). The cardinal sin is the Lie; the king's word is bond. The empire shelters the subject cults under Asturna's peace - the woodland council keeps its calendar of thanksgivings at the rite-longhouse beneath the fire-temple's tolerance. Worship vs demonization follows the culture's CURRENT alignment (worship_by_alignment).

clergy_ladder.5: Magupati (chief magus of a fire-temple) / Kowa-rotihontsa (head faithkeeper)
clergy_ladder.9: Magupatan Magupat (the chief of chief magi) / Kansaxsa-tha (the council's high keeper)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the hosts of Drauga the Lie (Persian) or demonized at the council (Woodland), keep their morphs + a hostile portfolio-epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhsha the Burner-of-Cities (woodland Waraksa the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Vakida the Devouring-Void (woodland Wasida the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusanta the Coin-Serpent (the Lie made gold; woodland Rusana the Greed-Serpent).

holy_symbol_motifs.Asturna: a winged ring-disc (the farnah-glory) above a fire-altar set before the longhouse
holy_symbol_motifs.Turvasa: a rayed sun above the upright Arta-measure and the longhouse
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlaspa: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Atash ([fire] of [power]) and its fire-temple (Atashkanusa) over the rite-longhouse (kanusa) of [power] and the forest-grove: 'the Atashkanusa of Turvasa', 'the Kanusa of Tularsa'; the magi keep the ever-burning fire (Atar) on the altar and the faithkeepers keep the council's thanksgivings.
religion.saints_pattern: the honest dead and the just kings (kept as fravashi and petitioned at the fire-altar; 'the Arta-true [name]') together with the founders of the council's peace and the honored clan-mothers and sachems, kept in the council's recital and at the burial-grove.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gayanta (the enduring earth and the rooted oak; woodland Kayansa)

religion.the_one: Asturna (< Aeternus / Itarnu / woodland Aterhonon; the Wise Lord Most High, the Sky-Holder-Above, upholder of Arta and source of the king's farnah-glory, revered above His ministers and acknowledged at the council-fire)

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (the hosts once named Drauga), and names the Lawful powers - and Asturna - as the tyrant-gods of a false order, to be defied; the council-peace is broken for the strong
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates Asturna the Wise Lord and the Lawful powers (Turvasa the just, Urlaspa of the sworn war, Naumana of the law, Arzanta of the road, Riyata the merciful), upholds ARTA and names the Chaotic powers the hosts of DRAUGA the Lie, warded; the fire-altar and the council-rite bind alike, and the king's word is bond
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the honest ancestral dead (the fravashi), the forest- and clan-spirits of the longhouse, and the thanksgivings to the growing things; the fire is tended and the council keeps its calendar, the great powers invoked situationally

titles._tiers_note: Old Persian ladder, ascending, with the Woodland council-substrate seated beneath. Vispati (clan-lord of a vis) barony; Marzapana (march-warden, the marzban) march; Framatar (appointed governor) county over a Parada (governed district); Xshacapavan (SATRAP, protector of the realm) duchy over a satrapy; Vispuhra (prince of the blood) principality over a great province (Dahyu); Xsayasa (king; the shifted Xshayathiya) kingdom over a Xshacam, shown in English as the approved foreign term SHAH; Xsayasa Xsayasanam (King of Kings) empire over the Vispa-Dahyu, all the lands. The woodland longhouse-clans keep their royaner (sachem) and the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner) who raise and depose the local chiefs beneath the Persian crown; the magi (magu) and the council-faithkeepers (rotihontsa) stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Old-Persian and Iroquois registers (allowed); the kingdom DISPLAY uses the approved foreign term 'Shah'.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, except the kingdom tier which uses the approved foreign term 'Shah' (a commonly-known Persian word, recorded in approved_foreign_terms_used). The *_native conlang forms (Vispati, Xshacapavan, Xsayasa, Royaner, etc.) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Persian-style court and feudal order over the woodland longhouse-confederacy: the Xshayathiya/Shah and the Vispuhra-princes of the blood at the crown, the Xshacapavan-satraps and Marzapana-wardens over the provinces, the royaner-sachems and clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner) of the longhouse-clans serving and seated beneath; the magi tend the fire and the faithkeepers tend the council-rite)
titles.heir: Mathishta (the greatest; crown prince / the heir) / Visa-puthra (the king's son)

vassalage.tribute: Baji (tribute) / Atste (the gift borne to the council)
vassalage.vassal: Bandaka (the king's loyal bondsman) / Rotiskenrakehte (the warriors)
